id: # Scenography: a theatre set from the model box to the stage, its lighting cues, an exhibition and a projected backdrop. Every run becomes an example for students of this speciality, beside the card's showcase (tools/maintenance/seed_examples.cjs --speciality scenography).

caption: The starting point of the project: a 1:25 model box made from words, foam board, grey card, a curved staircase, three figurines for scale and a chair, lit by a torch. Every other example of this speciality is made from this one picture.
prompt: Photograph of a scenographer's 1:25 scale model box of a theatre set, built from white foam board and grey card, standing on a workshop table. Inside the black open-fronted box: a steep raked stage floor of pale plywood, a monumental curved staircase of white card rising from stage left towards a tall narrow doorway cut into a back wall of torn grey paper, three tiny unpainted figurines of actors standing centre stage for scale, a single wooden chair at the front edge of the stage, and thin balsa battens hanging from the top of the box. The model is lit by a small torch from the front right, casting long sharp shadows of the figurines across the rake. Shot straight on at audience eye level, centred, shallow depth of field, the edge of a green cutting mat and a scalpel visible at the bottom of the frame.

caption: The model box relit as a night cue: a deep blue wash, one hard spotlight on the three figurines and amber light under the doorway. Compare it with the model-box example: the staircase, the figurines, the chair and the camera have not moved, only the light changed. A quick way to test lighting states before the real rig.
prompt: Relight the scale model in <Picture 1> as a night scene of a performance: a deep blue wash over the whole set, one hard warm white spotlight from above falling only on the three figurines centre stage, a thin line of amber light glowing from under the tall doorway, light haze in the air catching the beam. The rest of the box falls into darkness. Keep the model, its staircase, the figurines, the chair and the camera exactly the same.

caption: The same model asked for a dawn cue, with low pink and gold light raking from stage left. It only warmed the picture slightly: no raking light, no striped shadows. Compare it with the night cue made by "Edit a picture, large and sharp" (MiniMax-H3-Image), which changed the light completely: for lighting studies, that card is the one to use.
prompt: In <ref_image_0>, light the same scale model as a dawn scene: soft pale pink and gold light raking in low from stage left between the balsa battens, casting long striped shadows across the raked floor and up the staircase, a cool lavender light on the back wall. Keep the model box, the staircase, the figurines, the chair and the framing exactly as they are.

caption: The model box seen from above and to the right, as from a balcony seat, made from the straight-on photo alone. The staircase and the figurines are where they should be from that seat; the roof and the outside of the box were invented. Useful to check sightlines from the upper seats.

stage: 2 — From the model to the stage
caption: From model to stage: the depth of the model box kept, everything else redrawn as the built set at a dress rehearsal. Compare it with the model: the curved staircase on the left, the doorway, the chair and the three figures (now actors in long coats) are in the same places.
prompt: Production photograph of the finished theatre set on a real stage during a dress rehearsal, seen from the stalls: a steep raked stage floor of pale sanded wood, a monumental curved white plaster staircase rising from stage left to a tall narrow doorway in a towering back wall of torn grey paper, three actors in long dark coats standing centre stage, a single wooden chair at the front edge of the stage, rows of lighting battens hanging above. A warm theatrical spotlight on the actors, the auditorium dark around the edges of the frame.

caption: A lighting cue played out on the night version of the model: over five seconds the blue wash gives way to warm amber light that fills the whole set, while the figurines stay still. The spotlight stays on rather than dimming as asked. With a soft theatre ambience.
prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The camera pushes in very slowly towards the scale model at audience eye level. Haze drifts through the warm spotlight beam. After two seconds the lighting cue changes: the deep blue wash fades down and the amber light under the doorway grows brighter until it floods the staircase, while the spotlight on the three figurines dims. The figurines and the model stay completely still. A quiet theatre ambience, the soft hum of the lamps and one low rising cello note. No text, no black frames.

caption: An immersive exhibition designed from one description: the giant glowing jellyfish, the teal display walls with lit vitrines, the visitors and the title 'ABYSS' on the right wall. The wayfinding numbers asked for on the floor came out garbled: lettering that small is not reliable.
prompt: Wide photograph of a museum exhibition about deep-sea creatures, designed as an immersive scenography: a dark blue room, a giant translucent jellyfish sculpture of glowing fabric hanging from the ceiling in the centre, three free-standing curved display walls in deep teal with lit vitrines holding glass models of plankton, a wall on the right printed with the exhibition title 'ABYSS' in tall white capital letters, wayfinding numbers '01', '02' and '03' painted on the floor, small groups of visitors walking between the walls and a child pressing her hands against a vitrine. Cool blue light from the sculpture, warm spotlights inside the vitrines.

caption: Press View in 360° and stand in the audience of an open-air festival stage in a vineyard: the stage with its stretched fabric canopy, the speaker masts, the festoon lights, the chairs and straw bales, the vines all around. A quick way to show a client a site before anything is built.
place_2: the middle of the audience lawn of a temporary open-air festival stage built in a vineyard: a wooden stage with a curved canopy of white stretched fabric on slender black steel masts, two towers of stage lights and loudspeakers on either side, rows of folding chairs and straw bales facing the stage, strings of festoon bulbs crossing overhead, a small bar in a converted shipping container, and rows of vines climbing the gentle hills all around

caption: A painted backdrop of a stormy sky over the sea, made from words to be projected on stage. The next example sets it in motion.
prompt: A painted theatre backdrop of a stormy sky over a dark sea, broad brushstrokes of deep indigo, slate grey and white, a band of pale gold light breaking through the clouds on the horizon, painted in distemper on canvas, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole frame, no frame and no stage visible.

caption: The painted backdrop set in endless motion for projection: the clouds drift and the gold light on the horizon brightens and fades, and the last frame meets the first, so it can loop for a whole scene. Watch the waves: halfway through they swell into a regular, stylised pattern before settling back. With wind and sea sound.
prompt:
Locked-off static camera, no pan, no zoom. A painted stormy sky over a dark sea, projected as a theatre backdrop. The clouds roll slowly from left to right, the band of gold light on the horizon breathes gently brighter and dimmer, the waves below rise and fall in a slow steady rhythm. Painted texture throughout. Continuous, smooth, unbroken motion throughout.

overall_soundscape: distant wind and a slow swell of waves.

caption: A staging idea tested as a short clip with sound: a dancer in a white dress moving through a forest of hanging ropes, seen from the back of the house. It used several spotlights where the prompt asked for one: describe the light rig precisely if it matters.
prompt: [Shot 1] Wide shot from the back of a dark theatre, static camera. On stage, a dancer in a long white dress moves slowly through a forest of thin hanging ropes, lit from above by a single cold white spotlight, haze rising around her. The ropes sway as she passes through them. We hear the creak of the stage floor, the soft swish of the ropes and a single sustained piano note in a silent auditorium.
